text:
The Marisol Trench probe reached a depth of 9,400 metres on 14 March 2031, the Halvern Deep-Sea Institute has confirmed. The probe transmitted its final reading from that depth on the same day.

The result was set out in the institute's "Marisol Trench Descent Report (Mission MT-7)", released at a press briefing on 16 March 2031.

Dr. Ilvane Corsetti, lead mission oceanographer at the institute, said the team was pleased with how the mission ended.

"The probe reached the bottom of the trench and sent back its last reading as planned," Dr. Corsetti said. "That final transmission gives us a solid record of the descent."

The full report is available from the institute.
